sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM cards 
JOIN rulings ON cards.uuid = rulings.uuid 
JOIN legalities ON cards.uuid = legalities.uuid 
WHERE rulings.text = 'This is a triggered mana ability.' AND legalities.status = 'legal' AND legalities.format = 'premodern' AND cards.side IS NULL
